text_block_list.text:
One holiday—I headed to the park after 
being summoned by Gold Ship, only to find 
Mejiro McQueen there as well.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright. You two obviously know why I 
called ya here, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...No, not in the slightest. If this is 
another one of your nonsensical tests, I 
am going home desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, don't get all worked up. Look, 
check out over there.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Look at him. He wants to join in the fun 
again today, but he's too shy to say a 
word...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Is he the boy you mentioned before? 
The one you wanted to encourage—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, huh?! He actually existed!?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now is the moment Yakisoba Food Cart Inc. 
rides into battle! Together with him, the 
four of us will conquer the yakisoba 
world!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Y-You were serious about the yakisoba 
too?! And furthermore, your goal has 
shifted yet again desu wa!

And so... with nothing truly explained, 
the food cart officially opened for 
business purely through President Gold 
Ship's autocratic rule—

text_block_list.name: Timid Boy
text_block_list.text:
B-Boss! Two more orders of Ultra-Spicy 
Twice-Cooked Pork Yakisoba and Mega-Loaded 
Choco-Mint Yakisoba!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Look at you gettin' the hang of it! 
Alright, leave it to me! I'll whip 'em up 
in a jiffy—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Guh... Gwaaaagh~...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
D-Dammit...! I blew out the flexor digiti 
minimi brevis in my right hand! Guess 
spinnin' that fidget spinner all night 
caught up to me...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, kid...! The spatula is 
yours... I gotta pass the torch to you...!

text_block_list.name: Timid Boy
text_block_list.text: Eh... M-Me?! N-No way, I can't do that!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The yakisoba will be ruined at this rate! 
Please! You're our only hope...! I know 
you got what it takes...!

text_block_list.name: Timid Boy
text_block_list.text:
O-Only hope...?! I... have what it 
takes...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Listen close... Yakisoba is all 
in the snap of the wrist. Just like 
throwin' a shuriken—

text_block_list.name: Park Boy A
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?! Isn't that guy cooking yakisoba 
over there the same kid who's always 
watching us?!

text_block_list.name: Park Boy B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you can make yakisoba?! That's so 
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh, 'awesome' doesn't even begin to cover 
it! He's known as one of the Heavenly 
Kings of Yakisoba—take a bite and taste 
his mastery!

text_block_list.name: Park Boy A
text_block_list.text: Wait, really?! Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Park Boy B
text_block_list.text:
—So good! Dude, you're incredible! How do 
you make it taste like this?! Teach me!

text_block_list.name: Timid Boy
text_block_list.text:
Eh, ah... Ehehe... W-Well... um, it's just 
like throwing a shuriken—

And so—sparked by yakisoba, the timid boy 
began to open up and connect with the 
children at the park.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship-san, could it be... Was this 
your goal all along desu no?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yup, all according to keikaku. With his 
awakening leading to kid-approved yakisoba 
flavors... our company's supremacy is 
secured!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Why must you ruin a heartwarming story 
at the very end! Good grief!
choice_data_list: At least he found a way to connect.
Such is the power of yakisoba...
I'm kind of getting hungry too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well, that is true, but... In the end, did 
it really have to be a yakisoba cart...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Duh. Okonomiyaki wouldn't cut it, and 
takoyaki was a no-go. Only yakisoba 
could've delivered this happy ending!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You are making all of that up on the spot 
desu wa... honestly!

At any rate, the experience at the 
yakisoba cart surely left a mark on the 
boy's heart, giving him the strength to 
take that first step forward... probably.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah, exactly. Yakisoba saves all—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—McQueen. Just in case you ever lose your 
way, remember this: when in doubt, cook 
some yakisoba.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That is not profound in the slightest desu 
wa!

—Regardless, it was undeniable that here 
today, yakisoba had saved one young boy.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, can't be helped then. Golshi-chan will 
whip up some special Twice-Cooked Pork 
Yakisoba for you guys!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Didn't you claim just moments ago that 
you had injured your finger?

...In any case, enjoying delicious 
yakisoba together resolved everything 
nicely—or so one would hope. ...Surely it 
was for the best.
